_about: Where to sit on the train for the views (checked 27 Oct 2026). Keyed by the line a move rides, never by date, so a tip shows on whichever route is being viewed: a move matches a tip when it goes from a place in one of the tip's `ends` to a place in the other, either way ("*" is any other place). Each end maps a place to the station you board at, which picks the timing in `when_from`; `when_default` is [leaving from the first end, leaving from the second]. `weight` orders the tips on a move, ties in file order (the first seat tip is the one shown on the day and added to the booking reminders). `stations` turns the station names in the booking reminders ("Tokyo → Nagano") into places, so the reminders get the seat letter too. `reminders` are extra booking dates, merged into What's next by the loader (src/lib/data/loader.ts) the way data/food-deadlines.json is.
rule: On the shinkansen the seat letters stay on the same side of the track in both directions: the seats turn round, the letters do not.

tips.headline: Sit in seat E (D in the Green Car) for the Northern Alps
tips.ask: Ask for seat E (D in the Green Car) for the Tateyama range before Toyama
tips.where: The Tateyama range of the Northern Alps, between Kurobe-Unazukionsen and Toyama.

tips.headline: Sit in seat A (A in the Green Car too) for Mt Asama
tips.ask: Ask for seat A (A in the Green Car too) for Mt Asama after Karuizawa
tips.where: Mt Asama fills the windows just after Karuizawa, and again near Sakudaira.

tips.headline: Seat A also gets a short look at the Sea of Japan
tips.ask: Seat A gets a short look at the Sea of Japan near Itoigawa
tips.where: Near Itoigawa, over the town. A minor one.

tips.headline: Take the Yukemuri and sit up front, in the observation seats
tips.ask: Reserve the Yukemuri's front observation seats
tips.where: The Yukemuri limited express (an old Odakyu Romancecar) has front observation seats 1A–1D and 3A–3D: 8 seats, and we are 7.
tips.detail: Reserved, ¥300 each, on the Nagaden website from 0:00 JST 31 days before, for trains leaving 9:00–17:59; confirm the rule on nagaden-net.co.jp. The rear observation seats are unreserved: queue early. The Snow Monkey express has no observation seats.

tips.headline: Sit in seat E (D in the Green Car) for Mt Fuji
tips.ask: Ask for seat E (D in the Green Car) for Mt Fuji
tips.where: Fuji is in view for about 10 minutes between Mishima and Shin-Fuji.

when_from.Kyoto: about 1 h 25 – 1 h 40 after Kyoto, just after Shizuoka

tips.detail: Mornings are clearest; Fuji often clouds over by midday.

tips.headline: Big cases need a reserved last-row seat
tips.where: A case over 160 cm (length + width + height, up to 250 cm) needs a reserved last-row “oversized baggage” seat: free when you book it, ¥1,000 on board without it.
tips.detail: Nozomi is all-reserved 25 Dec 2026 – 5 Jan 2027; Hikari and Kodama keep unreserved cars.
